caption: The drawing depicts two views of a ceramic bowl: one from above (top view) and one from the side (profile view). The bowl is beige or light brown with visible cracks and imperfections, suggesting age or wear. The interior of the bowl, visible in the top view, has three floral patterns spaced around the rim and a single floral pattern in the center, all in reddish-pink with green stems or accents. The side view shows the bowl's flared, scalloped sides and a round foot. The same reddish-pink floral decorations appear spaced around the exterior, with one blue-green flower centered among them. The drawing is bordered by fine lines and has minimal background, set against an off-white paper. There is a handwritten inscription with a date (1937) at the bottom right corner.
title: Bowl
